# Hierarchical Bayesian model: posterior sampling with RStan
#
# Model:
#   y_i ~ Binomial(n_i, theta_i)
#   theta_i ~ Beta(alpha, beta)
#   p(alpha, beta) proportional to (alpha + beta)^(-5/2)

library(rstan)

rstan_options(auto_write = TRUE)
options(mc.cores = 4)

# Load the dataset (columns: y = successes, n = trials)
dat <- read.csv("/app/data.csv")
stan_data <- list(J = nrow(dat), y = dat$y, n = dat$n)

# Reproducibility: set the random seed to 1
set.seed(1)

# Posterior sampling: 4 chains, 100,000 iterations per chain, seed = 1
fit <- rstan::sampling(
  file   = "/app/hierarchical_model.stan",
  data   = stan_data,
  chains = 4,
  iter   = 100000,
  seed   = 1
)

cat("\nSummary of the fit:\n")
print(fit, pars = c("alpha", "beta"))

# Extract posterior samples (post-warmup) of alpha and beta
samples <- as.data.frame(fit, pars = c("alpha", "beta"))

# Posterior means
alpha_mean <- mean(samples$alpha)
beta_mean  <- mean(samples$beta)

cat("\nPosterior mean of alpha:", alpha_mean, "\n")
cat("Posterior mean of beta: ", beta_mean, "\n")

# Save results (single number per file)
writeLines(as.character(alpha_mean), "/app/posterior_alpha_mean.txt")
write
